ACROSS THE HALL FLOOR: camera at eye level out on the open floor, the forge set three-quarters away so one wall recedes into the picture, gear scattered near.
FROM THE CORNER OF THE FLOOR: camera low in a corner of the hall, the forge across the diagonal, the far wall falling away to one side.
OFF THE ANVIL DAIS: camera at floor level a few strides off the dais, the forge turned three-quarters, the hall opening out behind it.
PAST THE NEAR PILLAR: camera at eye level with one stone pillar closing the near edge, the forge three-quarters on beyond it.
FROM THE FAR END: camera at eye level at the hall's far end, the forge three-quarters away down the floor, depth stacked between.
BESIDE THE ORE CHUTE: camera at eye level at the foot of a stone chute, the forge angled away across the floor, one wall running off to the side.
IN THE ARCHED DOORWAY: camera set in a wide stone doorway, its jambs framing the near edges, the forge three-quarters on inside.
THROUGH THE SIDE ARCH: camera just outside a side arch looking in at an angle, the forge set deep and turned, the hall widening past it.
AT THE TOP OF THE ENTRY STAIR: camera at the head of a short stair inside the entry, looking down and across at the forge below.
UNDER THE LINTEL: camera close under a heavy stone lintel, the forge beyond it three-quarters on, the lintel's edge closing the near top of the frame.
FROM THE THRESHOLD GAP: camera in a broken gap in the hall's wall, the forge angled away inside, rubble closing the near edge.
FROM THE HIGH GALLERY: camera up on a timber gallery looking down across the forge at an angle, the floor and its gear laid out below.
OVER THE STAIR RAIL: camera on a stone stair partway up the wall, the forge below and turned, the rail's uneven posts crossing the near edge.
FROM THE LEDGE ABOVE: camera on a stone ledge high on one side, the forge three-quarters below, the hall's depth running away past it.
DOWN FROM THE CATWALK: camera on a plank catwalk under the roof, the forge far below at an angle, everything foreshortened.
LOW AMONG THE GEAR: camera set low among the working gear in the near foreground, the forge rising three-quarters on beyond it.
BEHIND THE QUENCH TROUGH: camera low behind a long stone trough, its lip closing the near edge, the forge angled away past it.
AT THE CART'S WHEEL: camera down at the height of a cart wheel in the foreground, the forge three-quarters on and large beyond.
BEHIND THE STACKED STOCK: camera low behind a heap of stock in the near corner, the forge turned away above and past it.
FROM THE FLOOR CHANNEL: camera set low beside a channel cut in the floor, the channel leading the eye at an angle to the forge.
BACK TOWARD THE FURNACE MOUTH: camera deep in the hall looking back at the forge and the wide opening beyond it, one wall receding.
FROM THE HALL'S BACK: camera far back where the hall runs out, the forge small and three-quarters on with the whole floor between.
PAST THE HANGING CHAIN: camera at eye level with a chain hanging close in the near edge, the forge turned three-quarters well beyond it.
ALONG THE HALL'S LENGTH: camera set to one side of the hall's long axis so that wall recedes hard, the forge set off-centre in it.
ALONG THE SHAFT LINE: camera at eye level under the long timber shaft that runs the hall, the forge off to one side and turned away.
THROUGH THE BELLOWS FRAME: camera at eye level just behind the bellows housing, its bulk filling the near edge, the forge three-quarters on past it and the vault rising above.
FROM THE SLAG HEAP: camera low beside a mound of cooled slag in the near corner, the forge angled away beyond it, one wall running off into depth.
BETWEEN THE TWO PILLARS: camera centred in the gap between two stone pillars, both closing the sides, the forge three-quarters on deep inside the hall.
ATOP THE FUEL STACK: camera elevated on a stacked pile of fuel beside one wall, the forge below and turned, the floor spreading between.
AT THE WATER BARREL: camera at the height of a wide barrel in the foreground, the forge angled three-quarters away past it across the floor.
BESIDE THE HANGING RACK: camera at eye level beside a low rack of hung tools, the rack filling the near edge, the forge turned well beyond.
FROM THE WALL NICHE: camera set back inside a shallow stone niche in the wall, its edges framing the near view, the forge three-quarters on across the floor.
UNDER THE ROOF VENT: camera angled slightly up from floor level beneath a wide roof vent, the forge three-quarters below the vent's edge, smoke rising past.
PAST THE FLOOR DRAIN: camera low near a wide drain cut into the stone, the drain line drawing toward the forge angled beyond it.
ALONG THE NEAR WALL: camera tight to one long wall looking at an angle, the wall's face filling one edge, the forge off-centre and turned in the hall.
FROM THE BROKEN STEP: camera at the height of a single broken stone step projecting from the wall, the forge turned three-quarters below and across.
OVER THE TOOL BENCH: camera just above the surface of a heavy stone bench in the foreground, its edge crossing the near base, the forge angled away beyond.
AT THE IRON HOOK: camera at eye level beside a large iron hook set into the wall, the hook cutting the near edge, the forge three-quarters on past it.
FROM THE UPPER VENT SHAFT: camera inside the mouth of a stone vent shaft near the roof, looking down at an angle, the forge foreshortened below.
THROUGH THE OPEN HATCH: camera looking through a square hatch cut in the floor above, down at an angle into the forge space below.
BESIDE THE SLAG CHANNEL MOUTH: camera low where a slag channel opens into the wall, the channel lip closing the near edge, the forge angled back across the floor.
FROM THE LOWER ALCOVE: camera set back in a low alcove cut into the hall's base, its stone shelf framing below, the forge three-quarters on outside it.
AT THE CORNER POST: camera close to a heavy timber corner post, the post darkening the near edge, the forge turned away across the diagonal.
ACROSS THE COOLING SLAB: camera at floor level across a wide flat stone slab in the foreground, the forge rising three-quarters on beyond its far edge.
FROM THE SIDE PASSAGE MOUTH: camera just inside a narrow side passage where it meets the hall, one jamb filling the near edge, the forge angled deep inside.
BENEATH THE STONE ARCH SPRING: camera set low where the arch springs from the wall, its curve overhead, the forge three-quarters below and across the floor.
PAST THE TILTED FLUE HOOD: camera at eye level with a stone flue hood leaning out from the wall in the near edge, the forge turned three-quarters beyond it.
FROM THE OPPOSITE HEARTH: camera at floor level beside a cold secondary hearth against the far wall, the forge three-quarters on across the hall with the floor between.
AT THE TIMBER THRESHOLD: camera at the height of a heavy timber set across the floor, the timber crossing the near base, the forge angled away and turned beyond.
DOWN THE RAMP SLOPE: camera on a stone ramp descending to the forge level, the ramp surface running down and away, the forge three-quarters at the bottom of the view.
ACROSS THE BELLOWS MOUTH: camera at eye level just beside the great bellows, its flank filling the near edge, the forge angled three-quarters on across the floor.
FROM THE CINDER HEAP: camera low at the base of a cold cinder mound in the near corner, the forge turned and large beyond it, the far wall dim.
BESIDE THE WATER BARREL: camera at eye level at the side of a wide barrel in the foreground, the forge three-quarters on past it, the hall running deep behind.
THROUGH THE SMOKE VENT SLOT: camera close under a narrow slot cut high in the stone wall, the forge below and three-quarters on, heat haze rising between.
UNDER THE LOW BEAM: camera crouched beneath a heavy timber beam crossing the near space, the forge beyond it angled away, the beam cutting the upper frame.
AGAINST THE FUEL STACK: camera backed against a wall where fuel is stacked in rough courses, the forge out on the floor three-quarters on and deep.
OFF THE DRAIN GRATE: camera set low directly above a large iron grate in the floor, the forge rising three-quarters beyond it across the open hall.
FROM THE SIDE ALCOVE: camera inside a shallow alcove cut into the hall's side wall, looking out at an angle, the forge set across the floor and turned.
AT THE HINGE SIDE OF THE VALVE: camera close beside a large pivoting air valve on the near wall, the forge three-quarters on beyond it, the floor stretching between.
ABOVE THE HOT GUTTER: camera elevated slightly over a narrow runoff gutter crossing the floor, the gutter angling toward the forge three-quarters on in the distance.
FROM THE COLLAPSED BAY: camera in a half-ruined side bay, broken stone closing the near edge, the forge intact and angled away on the open floor beyond.
PAST THE IRON POST: camera at eye level with a thick iron mooring post close in the frame, the forge three-quarters on past it, one wall receding.
ON THE STONE BENCH: camera at the height of a long stone bench along the near wall, the bench top running off to one side, the forge angled away across the floor.
BENEATH THE SUSPENDED BLOOM: camera low under a raw bloom of iron hung on a hook above, the bloom's mass filling the upper near edge, the forge beyond and turned.
ALONG THE PIPE RUN: camera at eye level beside a line of clay pipes running the hall's length, the pipes leading the eye toward the forge set three-quarters at the far end.
FROM THE FILL HATCH: camera crouched in a low hatch opening in the floor level of a raised section, looking across and down, the forge three-quarters on below.
PAST THE COOLING RACK: camera at eye level with an iron rack of cooling stock in the near foreground, the forge angled away and large behind it.
INSIDE THE WIDE FLUE BASE: camera set within the broad base of a stone flue tower, the opening framing the near edge, the forge three-quarters on across the floor outside.
AT THE EDGE OF THE ASH PIT: camera low at the lip of a rectangular ash pit sunk in the floor, the pit's edge cutting the near frame, the forge turned away beyond.
FROM THE SIDE LOFT LADDER: camera at the level of a timber loft ladder's top rungs against the wall, looking across and down at the forge below and three-quarters on.
OVER THE PLATE STOCK: camera directly above a flat spread of heavy plate stock on the floor, looking along it toward the forge angled at the far end of the hall.
BESIDE THE HOOD BRACKET: camera at eye level where a large iron bracket carries the forge hood, the bracket's arm crossing the near edge, the hall opening out behind.
FROM THE MEZZANINE STEP: camera on a single broad step of a stone mezzanine, looking out and down, the forge small and three-quarters on across the whole floor below.
ALONG THE TONG RACK: camera at eye level beside a long rack of hanging tongs on the near wall, the rack's line leading the eye to the forge turned away at the far end.
BEHIND THE BOSH BASIN: camera low behind a wide stone basin at floor level, its curved rim closing the near edge, the forge angled three-quarters on beyond it across the hall.
THROUGH THE SMOKE VENT: camera tilted up toward a square vent cut through the vault, the forge below and three-quarters on, heat haze rising between.
AT THE BELLOWS HEEL: camera low at the back of the great bellows, its bulk filling the near edge, the forge angled away beyond its nozzle.
FROM THE FUEL HEAP: camera set low against a mound of fuel piled in the near corner, the forge turned three-quarters across the open floor.
BESIDE THE SLACK TUB: camera at knee height beside a wide wooden tub, its rim crossing the near edge, the forge large and angled beyond.
OFF THE SIDE NICHE: camera back in a shallow stone niche in the hall wall, looking out at an angle to the forge set deep across the floor.
ACROSS THE CHANNEL BRIDGE: camera at eye level on a flat stone set over the floor channel, the forge three-quarters on, the channel cutting the foreground.
UNDER THE TIMBER TIE: camera looking up slightly under a heavy cross-tie spanning the vault, the forge below it and turned, the far wall beyond.
FROM THE HEARTH STEP: camera low on the step below the forge hearth itself, looking across and up at the body of the forge turned three-quarters.
PAST THE COILED CHAIN: camera at eye level with a heavy coil of chain heaped on the near floor, the forge angled deep beyond it.
AT THE CORNER BUTTRESS: camera close against a stone buttress at the hall's inner corner, the forge set well across the floor and turned away.
INSIDE THE LOWER ARCH: camera just inside a low inner arch, its curve tight over the top of the frame, the forge three-quarters on beyond the threshold.
FROM THE SLOPE OF THE RAMP: camera partway up a stone ramp rising along one wall, the forge below and turned, the hall floor laid out past it.
ALONG THE DROPPED BEAM: camera at eye level following a fallen beam lying at an angle on the floor, the forge sitting turned at its far end.
AT THE MOUTH OF THE SHAFT PIT: camera low at the edge of a square pit sunk in the floor, the pit's edge crossing the foreground, the forge beyond.
FROM THE FAR ALCOVE: camera set back in a recessed alcove opposite the forge, looking straight across the wide floor at the forge three-quarters on.
BESIDE THE HANGING TONGS: camera at eye level with a rack of long-handled tongs hanging close on the near side, the forge turned beyond them.
OVER THE IRON GRATE: camera low over a heavy floor grate, its bars crossing the foreground, the forge rising three-quarters on past the edge of it.
FROM THE HIGH VENT LEDGE: camera on a narrow ledge cut for access to the high vent, looking steeply down at the forge below and angled away.
PAST THE STONE PIER: camera at eye level on the inside of a broad pier mid-hall, its face filling the near left, the forge turned beyond it.
BEHIND THE ORE BARROW: camera low behind a heavy barrow parked on the floor, its body crossing the near foreground, the forge three-quarters on beyond.
AT THE ARCH SPRINGER: camera close to where a vault arch meets the wall at its base, looking up and across to the forge turned small in the hall.
FROM INSIDE THE FUEL BAY: camera set back in a deep bay cut into the wall for storage, looking out across the hall at the forge angled away.
DOWN THE RETURN FLUE: camera at eye level at the base of a wide return flue built into the wall, the forge visible across the hall and three-quarters on.
AT THE SPLIT THRESHOLD: camera low where two stone slabs meet at the inner threshold, their joint running into the frame, the forge deep and turned beyond.
FROM THE UPPER STAIR WELL: camera on an upper landing where a stair tucks into the wall, looking down and across at the forge below set three-quarters on.
